messages:
marta: Hey team — opened PR 4321 to add the migration guide for v2 model routing and updated the Python SDK snippet. Need a quick pass for voice/terminology before I merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

sasha: taking a look now. main things to watch: avoid 'model' shorthand when we mean 'model variant', keep second-person voice consistent, and prefer 'we recommend' over 'you must' unless it's mandatory.

alex: CI/docusaurus preview is flaky today FYI — I got a preview failed on my last push with the preview-bot timeout. Might be unrelated but worth checking before merge.

preview-bot: preview build queued for PR 4321. status: running...

marta: thanks. The SDK snippet was copied from internal samples; I simplified it but not sure about idiomatic Python style here. Also changed "default model" -> "default model variant" in a few spots.

harish: quick nit: in the examples we usually use `client.generate()` in Python snippets to match the SDK naming. Also prefer explicit kw args e.g. `client.generate(model="v2-small", prompt=...)` rather than positional.

alex: also watch formatting in fenced blocks — the docs linter flags trailing spaces and code block language markers. Example in the PR:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this text")
print(resp.text)
```change to:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}")
resp = client.generate(prompt="Summarize this text", model="v2-small")
print(resp.text)
```

sasha: agree with harish & alex. Also, watch terminology in the migration note: replace 'hot swap models' with 'model variant swap' and expand the sentence about KV cache invalidation — it's subtle and we should be precise.

marta: good catches. I'll update the snippet and the migration paragraph. Question: who can review/approve? I need at least one docs + one eng reviewer. @kim can you assign?

kim: assigning @sasha for docs review and @harish for eng. aiming to land today if preview passes. I can merge after both approvals and green preview.

preview-bot: preview build for PR 4321 failed: timeout contacting docusaurus worker (attempt 1). Logs: "Error: headless chrome failed to start". Re-run recommended.

alex: re-run done — preview is green now.

docs-bot: gentle reminder: please run `yarn lint:docs` locally; CI will block on lint errors.

marta: pushed updates (snippet kwarg, terminology changes, expanded cache note). PTAL.

harish: LGTM from infra side — snippet looks clearer and migration note handles cache invalidation well.

sasha: LGTM for style/voice. Small follow-up: replace one occurrence of 'we' with 'you' in the quickstart section to keep it user-directed. Not blocking.

kim: all approvals present and preview is green. I'll merge in 30m unless anyone objects. :rocket:
